history.period: 1946 onward in Mizoram (Mizo Conference became the first SDA conference in the Southern Asia Division in 1993)
history.summary: The Seventh-day Adventist Church in Mizoram is organised as the Mizo Conference of Seventh-day Adventist, under the Northeast India Union of the General Conference of Seventh-day Adventists, with its office at Seventhday Tlang, Aizawl. Adventism arrived in Mizoram in 1946, initiated by Lallianzuala Sailo, who first made contact with the SDA church at Shillong, Meghalaya, in November 1946; O.W. Lange was the first Adventist missionary to Mizoram, and the first Adventist school was started by Willis G. Lowry and Helen Lowry on 17 January 1950. The Mizoram section became the first conference in the Southern Asia Division of Seventh-day Adventists in 1993. As of 2024 the Mizo Conference reported 83 organized churches, 41 company churches, 191 isolated congregations and 19,204 members, running institutions including Helen Lowry College of Arts & Commerce (Aizawl), Southern Flower School (Lunglei), Graceland Adventist School (Keifang), Adventist English Academy (Saitual), Pinehill Adventist Academy (Champhai), the Aizawl Adventist Hospital and MED-AIM Adventist Hospital (Champhai), plus an Adventist World Radio studio inaugurated in 2003. IDENTITY NOTE: several SDA churches exist in and around Lunglei - listings include the SDA Church at Lunglei Chanmari (796701), one at Bazar Veng on Lungleithenzawl Road, and SDA churches at Haulawng, Bualte and Belthei (verify which the CSV row intends; one directory counts 4 SDA churches in Lunglei town). Adventists worship on the Sabbath (Saturday), observe the imminent Second Coming (Advent), and emphasise healthful living.

name: Lunglei Seventh Day Adventist Church
town_description: Lunglei is the second-largest town in Mizoram and the headquarters of Lunglei district in southern Mizoram, set on forested ridges at roughly 1,100-1,200 m altitude (the name means 'bridge of rock'). Historically it was the Baptist mission field: the first independent Mizo church building stood at Sethlun near Lunglei (1902), and the Baptist Church of Mizoram has its headquarters at Serkawn, Lunglei. Today the town has churches of many denominations in its localities (Chanmari, Ramthar, Rahsi Veng, Pukpui, Bazar Veng), including Presbyterian ones.

travel.road: Lunglei lies about 170-180 km south of Aizawl; connected by national highway with regular buses and shared taxis from Aizawl (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant, dry weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sabbath (Saturday) worship services are the main gathering; weekday service times are unpublished (verify locally). Visitors should note Sabbath observance runs Friday sunset to Saturday sunset.
